offence: Driving a motor vehicle on a road without a valid driving licence authorising that class or description
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (CPC default — first max 3 years is '3 years or upwards'; also qualified RTA s.127 for driver). Overrides under-3-years default
bailable: Not bailable (CPC default — max 3 years first / 6 years repeat)
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $20,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 years or both. Court may order forfeiture of vehicle for repeat (s.35(4)). Mandatory disqualification under s.42 unless special reasons

offence: Employing or permitting another person to drive a motor vehicle on a road unless that person holds a valid driving licence for the class
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (CPC default — max 3 years first / 6 years repeat). Qualified s.127 applies to person in charge
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $20,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 years or both

offence: Driving a motor vehicle on a road while disqualified from holding or obtaining a driving licence (or limited to class)
arrestable: May arrest without warrant (CPC default — max 3 years first / 6 years repeat). Qualified s.127 for driver
punishment: Fine not exceeding $10,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 3 years or both; repeat offender: fine not exceeding $20,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 6 years or both. Mandatory disqualification under s.42
